home.ctaTitle: Ready to bring your class online?
home.f1Text: Teach on Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams with your own free account. Students join with one click from the class page, and only after they've paid.
home.f2Text: Upload once, students watch anytime and pick up where they stopped.
home.f3Text: PDF, Word, PowerPoint and images, with your choice of preview-only or downloadable.
home.f4Text: Timed MCQ quizzes are marked automatically. Mark assignments with feedback.
home.f5Text: Monthly or one-time fees by bank slip or cash. Teachers approve slips, and unpaid months lock automatically.
home.f6Text: Each teacher's classes, students and files are kept completely separate.
home.featuresTitle: Everything a class needs, nothing it doesn't
home.lead: Run your tuition class from one place: go live, share recordings and notes, set assignments and quizzes, and collect fees. Your students join from any phone or laptop.
home.step1Text: Verify your email and your dashboard opens right away. No approval wait.
home.step2Text: Add the subject, grade, schedule and fee, then publish it.
home.step3Text: Students join, pay and start learning. You see who attended and who paid.
